en.title: Gemini 4 Carbon: A Developer's Guide
en.summary: Google has officially opened up Gemini 4 Carbon, built for deep reasoning and long-horizon Agent tasks, with a unified million-token context window and three adjustable reasoning depth levels. It's suited to demanding work like Bug review, architecture design, and scientific derivation, and can be paired with Argon and Flash to form a multi-agent pipeline with divided roles. The article covers pricing, migration tips, and five practical pointers for putting it to work — worth a try.

items_all.title: 人人都有 Agent 之后：我们在自己的 AI 社区里做 Team Agent
items_all.summary: 当个人Agent已经很难拉动组织效率，模数OPC社区带来了一套可落地的Team Agent实战方案。6人团队依托分域权限、事项绑定上下文的机制，让数字员工承接业务全链路，仅关键节点保留人工把关，搭配每日知识蒸馏形成持续学习的闭环。正在搭建团队AI协作体系的人，可以借鉴下。

en.title: After Everyone Has an Agent: Building Team Agent in Our Own AI Community
en.summary: When a personal Agent alone can no longer move the needle on organizational efficiency, the Modu OPC community has put together a practical, deployable playbook for Team Agents. A six-person team relies on domain-scoped permissions and context-bound tasks to let digital employees cover the entire business chain, keeping human review only at key checkpoints, and pairs this with daily knowledge distillation to form a continuous learning loop. Worth a look for anyone building a team AI collaboration system.

But the headlines the media have been running have gotten stranger and stranger — full of blatant racism. Now I see they're all just hired muscle out front, which forces me to take a fresh look at @AnaSwanson, the reporter who first published the spy story in the New York Times. Why did she go so hard on such an obviously absurd lead? Until I searched her past work — the recurring core sources across all her key AI and chip tech news stories and in-depth reports.
